'''Vader 1000 I Am An Agent Of Black Sun''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Vader 1000]]
* '''Published:''' 17 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 AOBS Vader1000 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck uses the objective Agents of Black Sun in the best way possible.  With Xizor, The Emperor, and Guri working for the agency, how can you loose???

== Strategy ==

First off, there aren’t any specific locations as to where characters and/or starships should be deployed.  The Emperor should just sit at the Imperial Square.  Him and Xizor can move around, but keep them together for the attrition bonuses.  Remember, Power 9 and some immunity to attrition is a terrible thing to waste.  Give the Naboo Blaster Rifle to Djas Puhr, the Assault Rifle to Jodo Kast, and use the Blaster Rack to exchange them.  Lastly, your best effect in the deck is Scum And Villainy.  Luckily with your objective out, only The Emperor will cancel it, and he’s not that important in your deck.  Just loose him, and then retrieve him with the 2 force retrieval.
Any suggestions or comments?  Email me at darthkling@yahoo.com
